representation: MODRISS JSON DSL mapped to SPEM 2.0

roleDefinitions.name: Product Owner
responsibilities: Value, release scope, acceptance, and risk decisions

roleDefinitions.name: Delivery Lead
responsibilities: Team coordination, dependencies, flow metrics, escalation, retrospectives

roleDefinitions.name: Solution Architect
responsibilities: PIM intent, provider-independent trade-offs, and architecture consistency

roleDefinitions.name: Cloud Platform Engineer
responsibilities: AWS resources, IAM, networking, observability, deployment posture

roleDefinitions.name: Quality Engineer
responsibilities: Infrastructure, contract, deployment, and operational verification evidence

roleDefinitions.name: Security Engineer
responsibilities: IAM, network, secrets, encryption, threat findings, and exception control

roleDefinitions.name: Service Owner / SRE
responsibilities: SLOs, observability, incident readiness, cost, recovery, and handover

roleDefinitions.name: Release Engineer
responsibilities: Versioning, promotion, approvals, rollback, and release evidence

roleDefinitions.name: Method Engineer
responsibilities: Maintains alignment between the modeling framework and development process as metamodels change

taskDefinitions.name: Plan deployable slice
steps: Select one PIM service slice or deployment unit to materialize on AWS.
Record AWS account, region, stage, networking, IAM, and deployment assumptions.
Define the PSM EVL gate, artifact-generation readiness criteria, and review participants.
entryCriteria: PIM transform complete, prior PSM increment selected, or greenfield PSM
exitCriteria: Deployable-slice scope and definition of done are agreed

taskDefinitions.name: Create AWS PSM model root
steps: Create or verify AwsPsmModel with partition and region defaults.
Link to PIM source model and set lifecycle metadata.
exitCriteria: AwsPsmModel root exists

taskDefinitions.name: Define stage and naming policies
steps: Configure AwsStage elements for dev, staging, and production.
Define AwsNamingPolicy and AwsTaggingPolicy conventions.
exitCriteria: Stage strategy and naming policies configured

taskDefinitions.name: Establish shared model contract and evidence conventions
taskDefinitions.purpose: Establish shared model contract and evidence conventions
steps: Apply shared identity, annotation, traceability, expression, lifecycle, and release-provenance conventions across AWS resources.
Record the source PIM revision, provider mapping revision, and review-state convention for the deployable slice.
Keep support and generated relationship concepts in detail views and evidence records rather than treating them as independent resources.
exitCriteria: Shared model contract and evidence convention are recorded

taskDefinitions.name: Create SAM stack and globals
steps: Create SamStack elements per deployment unit.
Configure SamGlobals for shared function and API defaults.
exitCriteria: Stack scaffolding ready for resources

taskDefinitions.name: Define CFN parameters and outputs
steps: Define CfnParameter, CfnMapping, and CfnCondition elements.
Configure CfnOutput and resource lifecycle policies.
exitCriteria: CFN scaffolding complete per stack

taskDefinitions.name: Configure IAM roles and policies
steps: Establish AwsSecurityBaseline with least-privilege defaults.
Create IamRole elements with inline and managed policies.
exitCriteria: IAM roles cover function and service principals

taskDefinitions.name: Provision KMS, secrets, and SSM
steps: Configure KmsKey and KmsAlias for encryption at rest.
Create SecretsManagerSecret with rotation rules.
Define SsmParameter elements for non-secret configuration.
exitCriteria: Security baseline applied

taskDefinitions.name: Configure VPC and subnets
steps: Create Vpc and Subnet elements when VPC-attached resources are required.
Configure VpcAttachmentConfig for cross-stack references.
exitCriteria: VPC topology defined for increment slice

taskDefinitions.name: Define endpoints and security groups
steps: Configure VpcEndpoint elements for AWS service access.
Define SecurityGroup and SecurityGroupRule for workload isolation.
exitCriteria: Network posture defined for workloads

taskDefinitions.name: Configure Cognito user pools
steps: Create CognitoUserPool elements from PIM identity providers.
Configure password policy, schema attributes, and recovery settings.
exitCriteria: User pools match PIM principal model

taskDefinitions.name: Configure clients, groups, and identity pools
taskDefinitions.purpose: Configure clients, groups, and identity pools
steps: Define CognitoUserPoolClient with OAuth configuration.
Create CognitoUserPoolGroup and CognitoIdentityPool for federated access.
exitCriteria: Identity resources match PIM auth model

taskDefinitions.name: Provision DynamoDB tables
steps: Create DynamoDbTable elements from PIM DataStore definitions.
Configure key schema, GSIs/LSIs, streams, and TTL.
exitCriteria: DynamoDB tables match PIM data models

taskDefinitions.name: Configure S3 buckets and policies
steps: Create S3Bucket elements from PIM ObjectStore definitions.
Configure encryption, lifecycle, notifications, and bucket policies.
exitCriteria: S3 buckets match PIM object stores

taskDefinitions.name: Create SQS queues
steps: Create SqsQueue elements from PIM Queue definitions.
Configure redrive policies and queue policies.
exitCriteria: SQS queues match PIM integration topology

taskDefinitions.name: Configure SNS topics and subscriptions
steps: Create SnsTopic elements from PIM Topic definitions.
Define SnsSubscription with filter rules and topic policies.
exitCriteria: Messaging matches PIM event channels

taskDefinitions.name: Configure EventBridge buses and rules
steps: Create EventBridgeBus and EventBridgeRule elements from PIM EventBus.
Configure targets, input transformers, and retry policies.
exitCriteria: EventBridge rules match PIM routing rules

taskDefinitions.name: Configure schedules, pipes, and connections
steps: Define EventBridgeSchedule elements from PIM Schedule triggers.
Configure EventBridgePipe and API destinations for external integration.
exitCriteria: Event fabric matches PIM integration

taskDefinitions.name: Deploy Lambda functions
steps: Create AwsLambdaFunction elements from PIM Function definitions.
Configure code config, layers, aliases, and environment variables.
exitCriteria: Lambda functions match PIM compute catalog

taskDefinitions.name: Configure event sources and permissions
steps: Configure LambdaEventSourceMapping for SQS, DynamoDB streams, and EventBridge.
Set LambdaPermission, dead-letter config, and tracing/logging.
exitCriteria: Compute matches PIM functions

taskDefinitions.name: Configure APIs and routes
steps: Create HttpApi, RestApi, and WebSocketApi from PIM Api definitions.
Define routes, resources, and methods per API style.
exitCriteria: API routes match PIM API catalog

taskDefinitions.name: Configure integrations and authorizers
steps: Configure ApiGatewayIntegration to Lambda functions.
Set up authorizers, stages, and WAF associations.
exitCriteria: API Gateway matches PIM APIs

taskDefinitions.name: Deploy state machines
steps: Create StepFunctionStateMachine from PIM Workflow definitions.
Select the concrete AslPassState, AslTaskState, AslChoiceState, AslWaitState, AslSucceedState, AslFailState, AslParallelState, or AslMapState classifier for every state.
Configure ASL transitions, retry/catch rules, branches, map processors, and logging.
exitCriteria: State machines match PIM workflows

taskDefinitions.name: Configure CloudWatch logs and metrics
steps: Create CloudWatchLogGroup elements for functions and APIs.
Configure metric filters and subscription filters.
exitCriteria: Logging and metrics configured

taskDefinitions.name: Configure alarms and dashboards
steps: Define CloudWatchAlarm and composite alarms from PIM SLOs.
Create CloudWatchDashboard for increment slice.
exitCriteria: Workflows and observability complete

taskDefinitions.name: Create integration relationship views
steps: Generate AwsRelationshipView elements for Lambda integrations.
Validate event source, API, and notification wiring views.
Apply AwsTag and ResourceImport for cross-stack references.
exitCriteria: Integration views cover all wiring paths

taskDefinitions.name: Complete trace and readiness
steps: Build TraceModel links across PIM and PSM resources.
Complete ProductionReadinessAssessment and resolve findings.
exitCriteria: PSM EVL passes; readiness gate approved

taskDefinitions.name: Review and adapt PSM increment
steps: Review AWS resource wiring, least-privilege posture, and artifact-generation readiness.
Record accepted scope, deferred deployment decisions, and operational feedback.
Create improvement actions and backlog adjustments for the next deployable slice.
entryCriteria: PSM EVL passes or all blocking findings are dispositioned
exitCriteria: Increment accepted or rework loop selected; improvement actions captured

workProductDefinitions.name: PSM Increment Plan
workProductDefinitions.description: Selected deployable slice, AWS assumptions, and deployment definition of done

workProductDefinitions.name: PSM Increment Review Record
workProductDefinitions.description: Deployment review outcomes, accepted AWS slice, and improvement actions

guidance.name: SAM stack containment
guidance.text: Most AWS resources live under SamStack. Establish stack scaffolding before resource provisioning tasks.

guidance.name: Generated PSM is a draft
guidance.text: Treat PIM→PSM output as AWS scaffolding. Refine IAM, networking, resource settings, integration views, and readiness before M2T generation.

guidance.name: Least-privilege IAM
guidance.text: Security baseline before compute. Lambda permissions and resource policies reference roles from the baseline.

guidance.name: Integration views for traceability
guidance.text: Relationship views denormalize cross-resource wiring for M2T and human review, create them before M2T generation.

guidance.name: Deployable slice discipline
guidance.text: A PSM increment is done only when AWS wiring, least-privilege posture, observability, traceability, and artifact-generation readiness are reviewed together.

sourceOfTruth: The project work tracker stores one process-run record per increment or release candidate.
The model repository stores the model revision, transformation run, validation evidence, and readiness assessment.
The release record stores the exact accepted model, generator, artifact, test, and deployment revisions.

aggregation.rule: Aggregate by increment, team, release, and product; never average away a blocking finding.
aggregation.teamCoordination: Publish a shared dependency board with ownership, dependency type, due date, and escalation path.
aggregation.reviewCadence: Daily local coordination, per-increment review/retrospective, and per-release readiness review.

metrics.name: Eligible task completion
metrics.cadence: each workday and at gate review
metrics.interpretation: Visibility only; never substitute for a usable increment.

metrics.name: Increment flow time
metrics.interpretation: Use trends to tune slice size and expose queues.

metrics.name: Rework rate
metrics.formula: reopened tasks caused by a finding / completed tasks
metrics.interpretation: Inspect causes; do not use as an individual performance score.

metrics.name: Trace coverage
metrics.formula: accepted scope items with source-to-evidence trace / accepted scope items
metrics.cadence: at every level gate and release
metrics.interpretation: A low value blocks confidence even when task completion is high.

metrics.name: Open blocking findings
metrics.interpretation: Must be zero or covered by an explicit, time-bound risk acceptance.

metrics.name: Manual decision closure
metrics.formula: accepted/rejected/waived manual decisions / blocking manual decisions
metrics.interpretation: Open decisions remain visible and are not silently treated as done.

metrics.name: PIM-to-resource trace coverage
metrics.formula: deployable PIM elements with an accepted AWS resource or explicit exception / deployable PIM elements
metrics.interpretation: Exposes unimplemented or intentionally unsupported platform mappings.

metrics.name: Deployment dry-run pass rate
metrics.cadence: per PSM increment and release candidate
metrics.interpretation: A pass is evidence for the exact revision, not a guarantee of production readiness.

metrics.name: Open security-exception age
metrics.formula: now - oldest open accepted security exception
metrics.interpretation: Every exception must have an owner, expiry, and compensating control.

governance.gate: M2T promotion requires an explicit user/model semantic-validation review; assistant apply/commit remains structural-only.

processEngine.description: Revolves through deployable-slice framing → network/identity → storage/messaging → events/compute → API/workflow → readiness per deployable slice.

deliverable.name: PSM increment slice
deliverable.description: Wired AWS resources and integration views for one deployable slice.

loop.guidance: After the phase-embedded review/adapt stage, revolve the PSM engine for the next deployable slice.

reworkLoops.name: IAM Baseline Rework
reworkLoops.trigger: Networking requires new IAM roles, KMS keys, or secrets.
reworkLoops.guidance: Extend security baseline, then replay networking.

reworkLoops.name: Storage–Compute Wiring Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Lambda mappings reference unprovisioned tables or buckets.
reworkLoops.guidance: Provision storage, then rewire compute event sources.

reworkLoops.name: Event Fabric Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Functions need EventBridge rules not yet modeled.
reworkLoops.guidance: Extend event fabric, then update Lambda targets.

reworkLoops.name: API Integration Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: API integrations reference incomplete Lambda or authorizers.
reworkLoops.guidance: Complete compute/identity, then rebuild API integrations.

reworkLoops.name: Workflow Observability Loop
reworkLoops.trigger: Step Functions targets changed after compute phase.
reworkLoops.guidance: Reconcile compute targets, then regenerate ASL and observability.

reworkLoops.name: PSM Readiness Rework
reworkLoops.trigger: Integration views or PSM EVL reveal broken wiring.
reworkLoops.guidance: Repair at source resource stage; regenerate views before M2T.

processEngine.spemMapping: MODRISS extension realized as an Activity(kind = Iteration) containing process Activities and WorkSequences.

workflows.name: Resize or Reconfigure Resource
workflows.trigger: AWS resource properties change (capacity, runtime, VPC, encryption).
steps: Locate resource in the phase that owns its eClass (storage, compute, API, etc.).
Apply NativeProperty or typed attribute changes.
Check dependsOn, IAM policies, and integration views for ripple effects.
Update relationship views; re-run PSM EVL before M2T.

workflows.name: Tighten IAM Posture
workflows.trigger: Security review requires least-privilege IAM changes.
steps: Return to Security Baseline phase; adjust IamRole, IamPolicy, IamStatement.
Replay compute and API phases for LambdaPermission and resource policies.
Regenerate integration views; verify no overly permissive statements remain.

workflows.name: Adopt Existing AWS Resource
workflows.trigger: Brownfield resource imported via ResourceImport instead of net-new creation.
steps: Add ResourceImport with stable physical ID.
Link to PIM trace source; avoid duplicate logical resources.
Refresh integration views to reference imported resource ARNs.

workflows.name: Post-M2T PSM Change
workflows.trigger: PSM changes after artifacts were generated or deployed.
steps: Apply PSM model change at owning phase.
Re-run PSM EVL and integration views.
Regenerate M2T artifacts; diff against prior generation.
Run CI validation and staged deployment.
